proposed_capability: Close PR #246 review findings and replay gaps in existing offline contribution tooling and route the independent-host pilot.
player_save_control_impact: Local training stays profile and context scoped, opt-in and private by default. Separate explicit consent is required to export model weights; weights can still leak training information. Export excludes raw samples, replay IDs, world/save hashes and names. Untrusted candidates are JSON-only data, never imported to live native gameplay or authorized as a controller. Developers and maintainers must manually review security, licensing and genuinely independent multi-host holdout evidence.
expected_outcome: Reject reused local capture IDs and exact repository bundle replays, stop directory enumeration at the documented cap, and reject overlapping VAE holdout vectors before scoring.
negative_tests: Reject a single local observation used for two semantic labels or actions
Reject an exact bundle copied under an alternate filename
Surface a repeated coarse case without claiming provenance
Stop iterating at the first directory entry beyond the cap
Reject identical, reordered and partially overlapping holdout vectors
Retain the zero-effect and no-auto-promotion boundary
rollback_path: Revert the isolated follow-up. No transfer-schema, profile, game or save migration is needed.
unresolved_unknowns: Reviewer-attested independent real-host evidence, candidate privacy and poisoning treatment, and exact-build Sims effect/rollback certification are unobserved.
Human maintainers retain contribution and release authority.
decision_rationale: Repair the existing evidence boundaries. Exact repeats of a complete bundle are redundant. The same coarse case in otherwise distinct bundles may represent real independent observations, so surface repetition to maintainers without attributing it to a source. Exact vector overlap invalidates the disjoint research check; disjoint vectors still cannot attest provenance.
